post.summary: Record a bookingless (open-gym) walk-in check-in.
post.description:
Staff-initiated and **not** feature-gated, matching
`POST /gms/v1/checkins/manual`. Runs every entitlement axis: walk-in dedupe
(409), `membership_status = 'active'`, venue entitlement, and pricing
consumption, in that order, so a replayed scan burns no entry-pack entry.

403.description: Caller lacks checkin:write, is a venue-scoped staff member not assigned to the venue, the member's membership is not active, the member is not entitled to this venue, or the member has no valid, paid plan covering this visit

404.description: Venue or member not found (an inactive venue reads as not found)

409.description: Member already walked in at this venue inside the venue's dedupe window

post.summary: Record a walk-in check-in from a member-held walk-in QR token.
post.description:
Staff scan the token the member minted via `POST /gms/v1/me/qr`. The member is
resolved from the token payload (a walk-in QR carries the member it
authorizes); the request body only carries the token and the venue. Feature-
gated on `QrCheckin`. Runs every entitlement axis walk-in does: dedupe (409),
active membership, venue entitlement, and pricing consumption.

400.description: Validation error / invalid or wrong-venue token

403.description: Caller lacks checkin:write, is a venue-scoped staff member not assigned to the venue, the member's membership is not active, the member is not entitled to this venue, or the member has no valid, paid plan covering this visit

404.description: Venue or member not found (an inactive venue reads as not found)

409.description: Member already walked in at this venue inside the venue's dedupe window

get.summary: Get the caller's own member profile.
get.description:
The member id comes only from the verified token, so this always returns the
caller's own row. Staff-only fields (`notes`, `user_id`) are projected out.

403.description: Caller is not a member principal

post.summary: Self-book a slot (idempotent on retry).
post.description:
Request body is `{ "slot_id": "<uuid>" }`. The member id comes only from the
verified token, so a member can never book for anyone else. A network retry
returns the existing booking (still 201). This write requires the
`MemberSelfService` tier capability, so a free-plan tenant is rejected with
403 FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE.

201.description: Booking created (or the existing one on retry)

403.description: Caller is not a member principal, tenant lacks MemberSelfService, or the member is not entitled to this venue

post.summary: Cancel the caller's own booking, subject to the venue's cancellation window.
post.description:
Ownership is baked into the query: a booking that is not the caller's own
surfaces as 404 (never 403), so there is no existence oracle for others'
bookings. This write requires the `MemberSelfService` tier capability.

parameters.name: bid
parameters.description: Booking id (UUID) of the caller's own booking

403.description: Caller is not a member principal, or tenant lacks MemberSelfService

404.description: Booking not found (or not the caller's own)

post.summary: Member self-check-in to the caller's OWN booking.
post.description:
Gated on the `MemberSelfService` capability (Starter+) and on the venue's
per-venue `checkin_scan_mode` (same as the self walk-in route). Ownership is
resolved from the verified token, so a booking that is not the caller's own
surfaces as 404, never 403. The policy check runs before the check-in write.

parameters.name: bid
parameters.description: Booking id (UUID) of the caller's own booking

400.description: Validation error (invalid booking id, or booking not eligible for check-in)

403.description: Caller is not a member principal, tenant lacks MemberSelfService, the venue does not allow member self-scan, the member is not entitled to this venue, or the member has no valid, paid plan covering this visit

404.description: Booking or venue not found (or not the caller's own)

409.description: Booking has already been checked in

post.summary: Mint a short-lived QR token for the caller's OWN booking.
post.description:
Gated on the `MemberQr` capability (Pro/Enterprise), like `POST /gms/v1/me/qr`.
Ownership is resolved from the verified token, so a booking that is not the
caller's own surfaces as 404, never 403. The minted `Booking` token carries
the booking id and no member identity (the member is resolved server-side at
scan time). Valid for 300 seconds.

parameters.name: bid
parameters.description: Booking id (UUID) of the caller's own booking

403.description: Caller is not a linked member, or the tenant's plan does not include member_qr

404.description: Booking not found (or not the caller's own)

post.summary: Member self-check-in (walk-in) at a venue that allows member scan.
post.description:
Gated on the `MemberSelfService` capability (Starter+) and additionally on the
venue's per-venue `checkin_scan_mode`: a venue must opt into member self-scan,
otherwise 403. The policy check runs before the check-in write, so a rejected
venue burns no entry. The member id comes only from the verified token; the
venue id from the body. Runs the same entitlement axes as the staff walk-in:
dedupe (409), active membership, venue entitlement, and pricing consumption.

403.description: Caller is not a member principal, tenant lacks MemberSelfService, the venue does not allow member self-scan, the member's membership is not active, the member is not entitled to this venue, or the member has no valid, paid plan covering this visit

404.description: Venue not found (an inactive venue reads as not found)

409.description: Member already walked in at this venue inside the venue's dedupe window

post.summary: Mint a short-lived, tenant-derived walk-in QR token for the calling member.
post.description:
The token is signed under a key derived from the caller's tenant AND the
`walkin` kind, so it cannot be replayed at another organization or as a
booking token. It carries no member identity. Valid for 300 seconds.

get.summary: List bookable slots at one venue the caller is entitled to.
get.description:
`venue_id` is REQUIRED (there is no all-venues form). `from` is REQUIRED (the
inclusive start day, ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`). `to` is OPTIONAL: when present the
query is the inclusive range `[from, to]` (max 62 days); when absent it is
`from`'s single day. Entitlement is enforced: a member may browse slots only
at a venue they are entitled to.

parameters.name: venue_id
parameters.description: Venue id (UUID). REQUIRED; must be a venue the caller is entitled to.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive end day (YYYY-MM-DD, max 62 days after 'from'). Omitted = the single 'from' day.

400.description: Missing/invalid venue_id, from, or range (from>to, or span>62d)

403.description: Caller is not a member principal, or is not entitled to this venue

get.summary: List members in the current tenant (cursor-paginated, searchable).
get.description:
Cursor pagination: pass `limit` (1-100, default 20); the response
`meta.next_cursor` (when present) is the `cursor` for the next page. There
is NO `offset`/`page` param. Optional case-insensitive filters: name/phone/email.

Optional `status` filter: `active` (active + expired) or `inactive`
(suspended). Omitted returns both. Cancelled members are a soft-delete and
are never returned regardless of this filter. An unrecognized value → 400.

For a venue-scoped staff caller the list is filtered to members entitled to
at least one of the caller's venues (chain-wide members are always visible).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a prior response's meta.next_cursor.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Activity filter: active (active+expired) or inactive (suspended). Omitted returns both; cancelled is never listed.

for `venue_scoped`). A venue-scoped staff caller may only assign venues they
have access to.

get.summary: List generated slots for a venue.

max 62 days) for the multi-day planning timetable. If `from`/`to` are
supplied they take precedence over `date`. Optionally filter by `resource_id`.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Single calendar day (YYYY-MM-DD, venue-local). Use this OR from+to.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive range end (YYYY-MM-DD, max 62 days after 'from'). Requires 'from'.

parameters.name: resource_id
parameters.description: Optional resource id (UUID) to filter slots.

400.description: Missing/invalid date or range (no date, from>to, or span>62d)

post.summary: Record a marketplace pass-holder check-in from a scanned QR.
post.description:
Staff scan the `PassBooking` token the pass-holder minted via
`POST /platform/v1/pass/bookings/{bid}/qr`. The token is keyed on the
scanning venue's tenant, so a wrong-tenant/forged token fails the MAC (401).
The booking, venue, and pass-holder are resolved from the token payload; the
booking is then settled under the platform role.

201.description: Marketplace pass-holder check-in recorded from a scanned QR

400.description: Validation error / invalid or wrong-shape token

`ChainWide` = every venue in the tenant (current and future); no
`member_venues` rows. `VenueScoped` = only the venues in `member_venues`.

PassPlan.description:
Monthly subscription plan determining credit allocation.

Credits expire at month-end (no rollover). Tier names and credit
counts from business doc §7.4 Tier Structure Sensitivity Table.

PaymentStatus.description: Manual payment tracking (no gateway in this feature).

Plan.description:
Tenant subscription tier. Persisted in `tenants.plan` (see the
`chk_plan_valid` CHECK constraint, which permits exactly these four
snake_case values). Drives feature entitlement via `capabilities_for`.

PlanKind.description: Plan kind: time-based subscription or count-based entry pack.

QrCheckinRequest.description: QR check-in request body (mirrors lambdas/checkin QrCheckInBody).

qr_token.description: Signed QR token scanned from the member's pass.

venue_id.description: Venue id (UUID) where the check-in occurs.

RecurrenceRule.description:
iCal RRULE string wrapper with basic validation.

Supported MVP patterns:
- `FREQ=DAILY`
- `FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=MO,WE,FR`
- `FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=SA;INTERVAL=2`

Full RRULE parsing (EXDATE, BYMONTHDAY, etc.) deferred to IWP-029.

RegisterOwnerRequest.description:
Request to create a new gym-owner identity (Spec B2). Identity only, no
venue data; the owner provisions their gym via the authenticated
`/onboarding/venue` after logging in.

RegisterPassHolderRequest.description: Request to register a new IziWellPass consumer.

Resource.description: A specific bookable unit (e.g., "Main Floor", "Room A", "Court 1").

ResourceId.description: Unique identifier for a resource (bookable unit: room, court, zone).

ResourceType.description:
A category of bookable resource (e.g., "Gym Floor", "Yoga Room", "Tennis Court").
Configured per tenant.

oneOf.description: The activity this resource type serves (None for legacy/free-form types).
The venue this resource type belongs to (None for legacy/free-form types).

ResourceTypeId.description: Unique identifier for a resource type (category: gym floor, yoga room).

Role.description:
User role within the IziWellPass platform.

Matches LLD section 4.5. Used in JWT claims and TenantContext.

Schedule.description:
A recurring schedule definition for a resource.

Maps to `schedules` table. Defines when a resource is available
using an optional RRULE recurrence pattern.

ScheduleId.description: Unique identifier for a schedule (recurring time definition).

ScheduleSlot.description:
An individual bookable time slot generated from a schedule.

Maps to `schedule_slots` table. Each slot has a date, time window,
capacity, and booking count for availability checking.

SeatUsage.description: Per-period seat usage for the overage meter.

SetMarketplaceRequest.description:
Request to toggle a venue's marketplace participation. `enabled` sets BOTH
`is_visible` and `iziwellpass_enabled` together. `credit_cost_per_session`,
when present, must be >= 1; when omitted the existing value is unchanged.

SetMemberVenuesRequest.description: Replace a member's venue entitlements (implies access_scope=venue_scoped).

SetPreferencesRequest.description: Request to replace a pass-holder's activity preference set.

SetStaffVenuesRequest.description: Request to replace a staff member's venue assignments.

venue_ids.description:
Full set of venues the staff member should be assigned to. This
replaces the existing assignments (not additive).

SlotId.description: Unique identifier for a schedule slot (individual bookable time).

Staff.description: A staff member at a venue (trainer, admin, receptionist, etc.).

StaffId.description: Unique identifier for a staff member.

TenantBilling.description:
A tenant's persisted billing record. `provider`/external ids identify the
subscription at the billing provider; `grace_deadline` is set when entering
PastDue. Timestamps are RFC3339 strings (the DB adapter formats them) so this
DTO carries no chrono dependency.

TenantId.description: Unique identifier for a tenant (maps 1:1 to Auth organization).

TenantStatus.description:
A tenant's lifecycle status. Serializes to exactly the strings the
`chk_status_valid` CHECK constraint permits (`migrations/..000003:44`, widened
to add `purged` in `migrations/..000030`): a value outside this set makes the
`UPDATE tenants SET status=...` fail at runtime, so the serde contract is
pinned by a test.

TenantSummary.description:
Operator-facing summary of a tenant row. `created_at`/`deleted_at` are
RFC3339 strings (the DB adapter formats them) so this DTO carries no chrono
dependency.

TenantUsage.description:
Per-tenant usage aggregate over an inclusive [from, to] date range. Summed
across ALL of the tenant's venues. This is the metered-usage source the
operator health rollup surfaces and P4 billing will reuse.

active_venues.description: Number of distinct venues that reported any metric in the range.

UpdateMemberRequest.description: Request to update an existing member. All fields optional (COALESCE pattern).

UpdatePlanRequest.description: Request body for PUT /gms/v1/venues/{venueId}/plans/{planId}. kind is immutable.

activities.description: When present, replaces the plan's activity subset.

UpdateResourceRequest.description: Request to update an existing resource. All fields optional (partial update).

UpdateScheduleRequest.description:
Request to update an existing schedule.
All fields optional — only provided fields are updated (COALESCE pattern).

UpdateSubscriptionRequest.description:
Request body for PUT /gms/v1/members/{memberId}/subscriptions/{subId}.
Set payment_status to mark paid; set cancel=true to cancel.

UpdateTenantSettingsRequest.description:
Body of `PATCH /gms/v1/tenant/settings`: the tenant's member-login policy.

Deliberately a single required field (not an `Option`): the route is a full
set of the policy, not a partial merge, so the caller always states the mode
it wants. Enabling `Login` is feature-gated on `MemberSelfService` at the
handler; switching to `Roster` is always allowed (a downgrade is never
blocked).

member_login_mode.description: The member-login mode to set for this tenant.

UpdateVenueRequest.description: Request to update an existing venue. All fields optional.

cancellation_window_minutes.description: Minutes before a class starts, after which a member may no longer self-cancel.

oneOf.description: Which QR check-in scan directions this venue accepts.

latitude.description:
Optional geographic latitude in decimal degrees. Must be provided together
with `longitude` (within this request) and within [-90.0, 90.0].

longitude.description:
Optional geographic longitude in decimal degrees. Must be provided together
with `latitude` (within this request) and within [-180.0, 180.0].

walkin_dedupe_minutes.description: Minutes within which a repeat walk-in check-in counts as the same visit.

Venue.description: A physical venue belonging to a tenant.

VenueActivityId.description: Unique identifier for a venue-activity link.

VenueCatalogEntry.description:
A venue as seen by marketplace consumers.

Maps to `venue_catalog` table (platform-level, no RLS).
Only includes venues where `is_visible = true AND iziwellpass_enabled = true`.

activities.description: Activity types this venue offers (denormalized from venue_activities).

distance_m.description: Distance from search point in meters (None if no geo query).

VenueDayMetric.description:
One precomputed rollup row: metrics for a venue on a calendar day.
Fields mirror the `venue_day_metrics` table (migrations 018, 025). Only the
honestly-computed columns are shipped (no `revenue_minor`).

credits_earned.description: SUM of pass_booking credits_spent for the day.

no_shows.description: Count of no-shows (swept confirmed pass_bookings past grace) for the day.

available_slots_7d.description: Number of available slots in the next 7 days.

next_available_date.description: Date of the next available slot (None if no upcoming slots).

VenueDetail.description:
Enriched venue view with availability summary.

Returned by `get_venue_detail` — includes the catalog entry plus
a count of available slots in the upcoming days.

VenueId.description: Unique identifier for a venue (physical location).

cancellation_window_minutes.description:
Minutes before a class starts, after which a member may no longer
self-cancel. Defaults to 120 when unset (see `cancellation_window_or_default`).
A value of 0 means a member may cancel right up to the slot start time.

oneOf.description:
Which QR check-in scan directions this venue accepts. Defaults to
`StaffScan` when unset, so member self-check-in is strictly opt-in.

walkin_dedupe_minutes.description:
Minutes within which a repeat walk-in check-in counts as the same visit.
Defaults to 1440 (24 hours) when unset (see `walkin_dedupe_or_default`).
A value of 0 disables dedupe (every walk-in is a distinct visit).

WalkinCheckinRequest.description: Walk-in check-in request body (mirrors lambdas/checkin WalkinCheckInBody).

venue_id.description: Venue id (UUID) where the walk-in occurs.

cognito_id_token.description: AWS Cognito JWT. Send the **ID token** (not the access token): only the ID token carries the `aud` claim and the org_id/role/permissions claims the API authorizer validates.
